description: This file defines the CLIInstaller enum responsible for managing the installation, detection, and status reporting of the openclaw CLI tool within a macOS environment. It includes methods for locating the installation, performing installation via shell script, and parsing installation events.

classes.name: InstallEvent
classes.description: A private struct used for decoding JSON output of installation events, encapsulating event type, version, and message.

methods.name: installedLocation
methods.description: Determines the current installation path of the openclaw CLI if exists.

methods.name: isInstalled
methods.description: Checks if openclaw CLI is installed by verifying the installation location.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Performs installation of the openclaw CLI, updates status via handler based on success or failure.

methods.name: installPrefix
methods.description: Returns the path prefix where openclaw is installed, defaulting to ~/.openclaw.

methods.name: installScriptCommand
methods.description: Builds the shell command array to download and execute the install script with specified version and prefix.

methods.name: parseInstallEvents
methods.description: Parses installation event logs from command stdout into a list of InstallEvent objects.

methods.name: shellEscape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in a shell command, handling quotes appropriately.
